what: Colgate-Palmolive sells toothpaste, toothbrushes, soap, home cleaning products and, through Hill's, premium pet food. Colgate is the most widely used toothpaste brand in the world.
customers: Consumers in most countries through supermarkets, pharmacies and small shops, and pet owners through vets and specialty retailers.
money: toothpaste, toothbrushes, soap, shower gel and cleaning products
Science Diet and Prescription Diet pet food
moat: Market leadership in toothpaste in dozens of countries, dentist recommendation, and distribution into small shops in emerging markets that took decades to build.
risks: Volume growth has been weak and sales rose only about 1% last year
Emerging market currencies reduce reported results
Own-label toothpaste and cleaning products take share in a downturn
opportunities: Return on invested capital near 28% is exceptional for a consumer goods company
Hill's grows faster than the core business and carries better margins
Emerging markets are about half of sales and grow with incomes
watch: Organic volume growth rather than price, and Hill's sales.
